paragraphs: On Thursday, May sat with Leo in the school library. It was club hour, and May had a job for Explorers' Blog. She wanted to write a page called "Meet an Explorer." "I ask the questions, and you give the answers," she said. "How old are you?" asked May. "I am eleven," said Leo. "Where do you live?" "I live in a small house with Mom, Dad, and Grandma."

"What do you eat for breakfast?" asked May. "On Monday, I eat rice with an egg," said Leo. "On Sunday, I eat cereal with honey." "With milk?" asked May. "No, I hate milk," said Leo. "I eat it with a big spoon and a lot of honey." May wrote, "Leo hates milk." "Please write that I love honey," said Leo.

"What is your favorite lesson?" asked May. "English," said Leo. "It is my favorite language, because I can read comics in English." "I like English too," said May. "What do you do after school?" "I draw cartoons for the blog," said Leo. "I draw before dinner, and I stop when Mom calls me." "Have you ever eaten cereal with milk?" asked May. "Once, when I was five," said Leo. "I never did it again."

May laughed and read the page again. "You are eleven, and you like honey, don't you?" she asked. "Yes, and I have a surprise for you," said Leo. He took a paper from his bag. It was a cartoon of May with a big pen. A small green parrot sat on her head. "That is Bill!" said May, and she laughed again. "Can I put it on the page?" she asked.
Teacher Kim read the page first, and she smiled. That evening, Lily put it on Explorers' Blog. Leo also looked at the blog on his phone. "Now all the Explorers know that I hate milk!" he said.
